label: The opening pieces of a strong verdict word that is still being spelled out over several tokens, good OR bad alike, strongest right after is/was: the first word of a vivid or ranking hyphenated verdict compound (jaw-dropping, mind-blowing, gut-wrenching, eye-watering, world-class, first-rate, second-rate, bottom-tier), 'out of this world', and inner chunks of a strong judging word written in ALL CAPS (INCREDIBLE, FABULOUS, HORRIBLE, TERRIBLE). Quiet on the same judging words spelled normally in lowercase as one token (incredible, terrible), on mild verdict compounds (half-baked, so-so, run-of-the-mill), on hyphenated compounds with no verdict (first-floor, top-down), on literal phrases (around the world), and on neutral words in caps (DELIVERED).

qc.label_under_test: The opening pieces of an intense, extreme verdict word that is still being spelled out over several tokens, strongest right after is/was: the first word of a vivid hyphenated praise or awe compound or idiom (jaw-dropping, eye-watering, mind-blowing, first-rate, first-class, world-class, out of this world) and inner chunks of a strong judging word written in ALL CAPS (INCREDIBLE, AMAZING, TERRIBLE). Quiet on the same judging words spelled normally in lowercase as one token (incredible, terrible, amazing), on mild or middling verdict compounds (second-rate, run-of-the-mill), on hyphenated compounds with no verdict (first-floor, top-down), on literal phrases (around the world), and on neutral words in caps (DELIVERED).
